messages:
maria: Hi infra team — we need quota increases in a NEW AWS account for an upcoming Dedicated onboarding. Account ID: 123456789012. Target region: sa-east-1 (São Paulo).

maria: Requesting the following (start target: 2026-04-05):
- p5 instances: 10 (concurrent)
- p4d instances: 2
- g5 instances: 8
- ENI quota bump: +200 (we're hitting ENI limits across multiple subnets)
- EIPs: +50
- EC2 instances per region: +100
- Request placement groups and higher EBS IOPS baseline for these instances

maria: Reason: onboarding 3rd-party tenant (multi-tenant Dedicated pool). We'll run steady-state throughput and need headroom for canary rollouts. Estimated sustained GPU hours: 10k / month. Billing contact: finance@redwood.ai.

sachin: thanks — can you paste the exact account alias/ARNs and the VPC IDs we'll use? AWS support asks for VPC/subnet details when ENI increases touch classic limits.

maria: account alias: redwood-dedicated-sae. VPCs: vpc-0a1b2c3d, vpc-0f9e8d7c. Subnets (public/private): subnet-0aa11bb22cc33, subnet-0dd44ee55ff66.

jordan: do we need to request any soft limit increases for network interfaces per instance type? G5/p5 might require larger ENI per instance. Also request higher ephemeral port range?

maria: good call — add "NetworkInterfacesPerInstance for p5/p4d/g5" to the case.

ramon: tagging note — please include the internal cost center tag: cost-center:dedicated-onboard and the sales rep name: ella@sales. We'll need approval from sales for reserve capacity.

infra-bot: AWS support case template inserted: reply with this exact body to speed up case creation.

infra-bot: ```
Subject: Quota increase request for GPU fleet + ENIs — account 123456789012 (sa-east-1)

Hello AWS Support,

We request quota increases for the following resources in region sa-east-1 for account 123456789012. This is a production onboarding for a paid customer. Desired effective date: 2026-04-05.

Requested increases:
- EC2: p5 (all sizes) — target concurrent instances: 10
- EC2: p4d.24xlarge — target concurrent instances: 2
- EC2: g5.12xlarge (and equivalents) — target concurrent instances: 8
- ENI (Elastic Network Interfaces) — increase quota by 200 across the region to support multi-VPC deployment
- Elastic IPs (EIP) — increase by 50
- EC2 instances (regional) — increase by 100
- NetworkInterfacesPerInstance — increase to support allocations for the above GPU families
- Placement Groups quota and ability to allocate cluster placement groups for HPC-like scheduling
- EBS baseline IOPS / throughput increases for the above instance families

Justification: Dedicated inference fleet for a commercial tenant. We need capacity for onboarding, canary deploys, and predictable throughput. We expect ~10k GPU hours/month and will commit to reserved capacity if needed. Please expedite — production SLA required.

Contact: maria@redwood.ai, infra escalation: +1-555-0123
Account alias: redwood-dedicated-sae
VPCs: vpc-0a1b2c3d, vpc-0f9e8d7c
Subnets: subnet-0aa11bb22cc33, subnet-0dd44ee55ff66

Thanks,
Redwood Inference - Infra
```

maria: I filed the case just now. AWS case ID: 9876543210. Filed with priority: production. Copy of the case body pasted above.

aws-support-bot: Update: case 9876543210 created (level: production). Current status: awaiting AWS internal review. Estimated response: 24-48 hours.

jordan: also opened an internal tracker: INT-5629 and added the sales rep. Ramon please confirm budget ok for potential on-demand burst while waiting for quota.

ramon: budget approved for 2 weeks of burst at current rates. If AWS asks for usage justification, we have the commitment from sales.

maria: great — I'll follow up when AWS responds. If they request placement group limits, we'll include benchmarks + workload profile.

sachin: once approved, I'll run a small canary deploy and smoke test ENI allocation across AZs. Please ping me in thread when case changes. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks all — tagging infra runbook owner @jordan for the post-approval checklist.

aws-support-bot: Notification: case 9876543210 status changed to "Information required". AWS needs confirmation of EIP usage and whether Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA) is required for p5 clusters.

maria: replied to AWS: we do NOT require EFA for initial onboarding. EIP usage: reserved for public NAT/gateway egress for customer workloads (approx 40 EIPs). Requested EFA flag: NO.

aws-support-bot: AWS acknowledged — case 9876543210 moved to "Case submitted to service team". ETA: 36 hours.

maria: noted — I'll update INT-5629 with the final outcome. Thanks everyone.
